newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto to benefit from Asgrow.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto to benefit from Asgrow.

text.p: -- Natwest Securities analysts said Tuesday Monsanto Co's plans to buy Asgrow Agronomics from Empresas La Moderna SA for $240 million will help Monsanto reach some near- and long-term objectives.

-- "For the near-term, Asgrow adds to Monsanto's Roundup franchise by giving the company more control of Roundup Ready soybean sales," Natwest said in a report. "In 1996, Asgrow was the largest marketer of Roundup Ready soybeans, accounting for most of the one million acres worth of seeds sold."

-- Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc and DeKalb Genetics Corp also will begin selling these seeds in significant quantity in 1997. Roundup Ready soybeans are resistant to Monsanto's Roundup herbicide used to kill weeds in the field.

-- "We believe the Asgrow business, coupled with Monsanto's Hartz seed subsidiary, will give Monsanto the lead market share position in Roundup Ready soybeans sales in 1997," said Natwest, which rates Monsanto a hold.
-- Longer term, Natwest said the Agrow deal will help Monsanto capture value downstream at the seed level from its genetic engineering innovations.
